title: DuROCK EIFS
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC describes the evaluated products as non-loadbearing EIFS systems that may be panel-assembled or field-applied and use a WRB, attachment, insulation board and lamina.
The NBC 2020 opinion classifies Article 3.1.5.5, Combustible Cladding on Exterior Walls, as Acceptable for the evaluated use, subject to stated conditions and limitations.
facts.locator: CCMC 12969-R PDF, p. 2, Compliance opinion table

facts.text: The published report gives a product flame-spread-rating range and test standard for the specified insulation component; it does not supply a project assembly.
facts.locator: CCMC 12969-R PDF, p. 6, Product information / fire-related material requirements

limitations: The CCMC opinion does not review a particular building or wall assembly.
Product-level component data must not be treated as an assembly result without matching the report’s conditions.
